extraction_notes: Exact identity verified: LMBT5551LT1G, LRC (Leshan Radio Company, Ltd.), NPN high-voltage transistor; assigned PDF SHA-256 1bb33c8bedd3f2866ab591eeaa08166986ef3c5354689b053615321110885577.
The supplied datasheet covers LMBT5550 and LMBT5551 variants. All extracted bounds are the LMBT5551LT1G rows; shared Both Types rows are used only where the table explicitly applies to both types.

The PDF specifies VCEO = 160 V minimum for LMBT5551, VCBO = 180 V minimum, VEBO = 6.0 V minimum, continuous IC = 600 mA maximum, and PD = 225 mW maximum on FR-5 at TA = 25 degC; only VCEO is represented by the strict schema.

Figure 4 provides typical VBE(sat) and VCE(sat) curves at TJ = 25 degC and IC/IB = 10. Curve points are compact approximate direct readings from visible grid positions, expressed in SI units; no interpolation was used and the curves are not guaranteed limits.
The p. 3 Figure 15 hFE plot is normalized and contains multiple temperature and VCE traces, so it was not digitized as a scalar or curve. The table bounds are retained directly instead.

The PDF has no tabulated fT, Cobo, or Cibo values. Figure 7 shows typical capacitance curves, but those curves were omitted from the compact DC extraction and the strict scalar fields remain null rather than treating approximate plot readings as table bounds.

No Early-voltage scalar is emitted: the available output-related plot is a collector saturation-region characteristic rather than a robust forward-active output family for VAF extraction. Temperature coefficients, switching times, cutoff curves, thermal data, and package dimensions are not represented by the strict schema.
omission_reason: The datasheet has usable typical DC on-voltage curves, which are included as compact approximate readings. It does not provide tabulated fT, Cobo, or Cibo values, and the available non-DC plots were not transcribed into the compact strict-schema extraction. No robust Early-voltage scalar is available from the supplied plots.
